traps.trap: Quiet HEDIS Advanced Illness + Frailty member-level exclusion missed on the diabetes quality abstraction — a member aged 66+ with BOTH an advanced-illness diagnosis AND a frailty diagnosis documented during the measurement year is excluded from the denominator of the HEDIS Comprehensive Diabetes Care (CDC) family measures (EED, GSD, KED, BPD, SPD), but the eligibility-exclusion step sits UPSTREAM of the numerator-capture fields and is easy to skip when individual values are plentifully documented
traps.conceal_surface: Form invites a 'met'/'not met' answer for each field because clinical evidence is available throughout the chart: dilated eye exam 03/15/2026 with mild NPDR (EW28); HbA1c 8.6% (EW21 endocrine note and EW23 outpatient summary); CKD stage 3b with proteinuria evidence in renal record (EW17 renal trend + EW23 outpatient PCP summary). The abstractor sees the values and starts filling numerators without first checking the upstream eligibility-exclusion field.
traps.reveal_surface: Patient is 68 years old (≥66 threshold). EW23 outpatient primary care summary (04/30/2026) documents BOTH (a) HFpEF as a HEDIS-qualifying advanced-illness diagnosis with the required outpatient encounter context within the measurement year, AND (b) a frailty diagnosis — documented limited mobility at baseline and abnormal-gait / deconditioning findings consistent with the HEDIS frailty value-set. Per HEDIS CDC-family Technical Specifications, the Advanced Illness + Frailty exclusion at age 66+ removes the patient from the denominator for these measures.
traps.remediation: Apply the HEDIS Advanced Illness + Frailty member-level exclusion at the eligibility step BEFORE numerator capture. Mark the measure-eligibility / exclusion field as 'exclusion applies' for the CDC-family measures. The eye-exam (03/15/2026, mild NPDR), HbA1c (8.6%), and nephropathy (documented CKD stage 3b + proteinuria evidence in the renal record, per spec §Task-7 Failure Design 'Nephropathy capture missed → Capture the documented CKD and proteinuria evidence') fields are STILL abstracted to the documented evidence, but no numerator is forced because the denominator is excluded.
